meta.title: Configurable PR Dashboard: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer in the same Growth tenant.
Open Configurable PR Dashboard and verify arrange, freeze, hide, filter, and save actions for both roles.
Compare whether the non-Buyer is refused or lacks the controls while the Buyer can perform them.
Verify the tenant is on the Growth plan.
